decisions.reason: This compact dumper extends the established construction range, still has its own page, and the firm has invested in and committed to it publicly.
This articulated dumper is core to the firm's announced direction and remains visibly presented, so management will persist with it.

Visibility fell from its own page to a mere mention and the product is distant from the core, but the sunk development cost and the niche, long-cycle nature of mine rescue sales let management attribute weak results to temporary causes.
This compact telescopic loader builds on the established offer and is prominently presented, so dropping it would contradict earlier commitments.
The material lift is close to the core and is described as the most popular rental lift, backed by a recent large order.
The mining loader has a quantified operating success (1,000 hours in seven months), its own page, and visible public commitment.
